sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Hoozoto: Aztec Guardian''' is a minor hero with 2 ATK and 2 DEF. That might seem average at first, but his special power makes him a really good choice in Missions like [[TCG:SAS-147|Escape With the Ring of Arc]], [[TCG:SAS-148|Retrieve the Ring of Arc]], and [[TCG:SAS-157|Control the Idols of Omeed]]. Anytime Hoozoto is holding an object, like a [[TCG:SAS-162|Golden Idol]] or the [[TCG:SAS-164|Ring of Arc]], he gets an extra 2 ATK and 2 DEF. This makes him a powerful 4 ATK and 4 DEF behemoth of a minor hero capable of dealing with some major heroes and multiple minor heroes before being KO'd.
